text:
mike_r: starting overnight trickle for v2.2.0 (US -> EU -> APAC). low-risk ramp: 2% -> 8% -> 20%. ops please watch capacity and pin rules.

deploy-bot: preflight summary (us): model=v2.2.0, slice=2%, warmup=10m, gpus free=18/24, kv_cache primed. smoke p95=95ms, errors=0.05%.

li_chen: thanks. can ops confirm sustained token-per-sec and if any cold-start spikes?

ops_ana: US sustained TPS steady at 1400 t/s over 8m. occasional cold-start burst observed during scale events (~250ms extra tail). setting scale-smoothing to 30s.

ravi: adding rollout safety rule: if p95 > 200ms OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m -> immediate downgrade to fallback v2.1.3 and global pin. also add auto-scale pause on thermal warn.

mike_r: agreed. new fallback version is v2.1.3 (last stable). pin policy: pin by orchestration api and post to #support.

deploy-bot: EU preflight queued. command: ```sh
./infra/deployctl preflight --region eu --model v2.2.0 --slice 8 --warmup 10m --reserve-warmpool 2
```

li_chen: EU GPU pool shows 11/12 free, but note scheduled evacuate on infra-node-7 in 25m (non-blocking).

ops_ana: holding APAC start. maintenance window in ap-northeast-1 from 02:00->02:45 local. APAC will start after that +15m buffer. reserving burst nodes post-maintenance.

kelly_s: Observability checklist appended: cost alert +25% baseline, quality regression run using promptset "checkout_flow", slack webhook to #eng-releases for tag deploy:rollback-signal, enable trace sampling x5 for first 20m.

deploy-bot: EU smoke run: p95=162ms, errors=0.2%, kv hit=79%. ready to scale to 8%.

mike_r: scaling EU to 8% now. manual command: ```sh
./infra/deployctl scale --region eu --percent 8 --reason "staged-warmup"
```

deploy-bot: EU scaled to 8% -> holding for 12m. p95 trending 170ms.

li_chen: if eu p95 creeps above 180ms for 2m, reduce to 5% preemptively.

ops_ana: set auto-stepdown: if p95>180ms for 2m OR cpu>85% for 3m -> scale --percent 5. implementing now.

ravi: reminder: manual rollback command: ```sh
./infra/deployctl rollback --region $REGION --to v2.1.3 --note "ops/auto-trigger"
```

kelly_s: pin-all API for emergency: POST /internal/rollouts/pin body: ["us","eu","apac"] version="v2.1.3" auth: ops-token. use only after consult with on-call.

deploy-bot: EU at 8% stable for 13m. p95=168ms, errors=0.19%. US still green. APAC pending maintenance.

ops_ana: APAC maintenance finished early. warming burst nodes; recommend gentle start at 2% in 10m, heat to 8% over 15m.

mike_r: ok hold 10m then start. if APAC p95 >220ms or error>0.6% -> fallback to EU-hosted replicas for dev-tier and pin APAC to v2.1.3.

li_chen: posting short release note for support: v2.2.0 rc1 staged roll (perf kernels + cache priming). Ramp US->EU->APAC. Rollback triggers: p95>200ms or errors>0.5% for 3m. Global pin -> v2.1.3.

kelly_s: I'm attaching the small playbook to the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/rollout-v2.2.0 (link).

mike_r: thanks team. i'll announce to #general if APAC reaches 20% and holds 15m. closing thread after full steady state or pinned rollback. :rocket:
